principles.why: The bright white truck stands out against dark canopy shadows.

tips.name: Value contrast
tips.tip: Keep the truck white while darkening surrounding canopy shadows.

principles.why: Diagonal curb line leads the eye toward central gate structure.

tips.name: Leading lines
tips.tip: Taper road lines toward center to deepen perspective.

principles.why: Repeating vertical canopy pillars create a structured architectural grid.

tips.name: Vertical alignment
tips.tip: Keep vertical pillar edges parallel across the entire structure.

principles.why: Overhead canopy roof line ties all structural elements together.

tips.name: Continuous beam
tips.tip: Draw main roof beam in one confident continuous stroke.

principles.why: Symmetrical openings on both sides balance the central booth.

tips.name: Symmetrical framing
tips.tip: Match dark negative space shapes on left and right sides.

principles.why: Paved ground patch introduces brick texture against flat canopy.

tips.name: Texture contrast
tips.tip: Use quick pen strokes to suggest foreground paving bricks.

principles.why: Ground road spacing defines scale between booth and side pillars.

tips.name: Measuring width
tips.tip: Compare ground gap widths against pillar thickness before drawing.

tips.name: Repeating gaps
tips.tip: Repeat shadow intervals along pavement to suggest rhythmic depth.

relationships.why: Bright pickup body pops against dark shaded booth canopy background.

tips.name: High contrast
tips.tip: Leave white paper raw for the truck body.

relationships.why: Dark canopy opening frames the white truck in middle ground.

tips.name: Frame subject
tips.tip: Darken frame edges to focus eyes on central vehicle.

relationships.why: Diagonal curb line directs visual attention toward the white pickup.

tips.name: Guide eyes
tips.tip: Strengthen line weight along foreground curb to lead entry.

relationships.why: Vertical structural pillars repeat matching rectangular shapes across entrance.

tips.name: Repeat forms
tips.tip: Maintain equal spacing between structural vertical pillars.

relationships.why: Dark gray architectural color holds top of frame together.

tips.name: Unified wash
tips.tip: Apply a single dark watercolor wash across top beam.

relationships.why: Open dark spaces on both sides distribute visual weight evenly.

tips.name: Even weight
tips.tip: Balance dark washes on both sides of central booth.

relationships.why: Rough ground brick texture contrasts with flat dark canopy.

tips.name: Surface change
tips.tip: Hatch ground details while keeping upper structure smooth.

relationships.why: Width of central road passage gives relative scale to structure.

tips.name: Check scale
tips.tip: Gauge lane widths relative to central booth height.

stroke_order_note: The gate came first, then the curb, the canopy and the truck.
